name: Hestia
desc: Esquema de la base de datos de Hestia. Se genera solo a partir de las migraciones; no se edita a mano.

indexes.name: users_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON auth.users USING btree (id)

tables.name: public.categories
tables.comment: Tipos de gasto de cada grupo (supermercado, ocio...). Se borran de forma suave.

columns.name: category_name
columns.comment: Nombre de la categoría. Único entre las categorías activas del grupo.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.comment: Si tiene valor, la categoría está borrada. Nunca se borra de verdad.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Se actualiza sola con un trigger. Sirve para sincronizar cambios.

indexes.name: categories_group_name_active_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_group_name_active_key ON public.categories USING btree (group_id, category_name) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: categories_group_updated_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX categories_group_updated_idx ON public.categories USING btree (group_id, updated_at)

indexes.name: categories_id_group_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_id_group_id_key ON public.categories USING btree (id, group_id)

indexes.name: categories_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_pkey ON public.categories USING btree (id)

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.categories FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.expense_groups
tables.comment: Una familia o grupo. Todo lo demás cuelga de un grupo.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Nombre visible del grupo.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Se actualiza sola con un trigger. Sirve para sincronizar cambios.

indexes.name: expense_groups_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expense_groups_pkey ON public.expense_groups USING btree (id)

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.expense_groups FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.expense_splits
tables.comment: Reparto de un gasto: una fila por miembro con la parte que le toca. Se crean junto al gasto y no se editan.

columns.name: group_id
columns.comment: Grupo del gasto. Permite filtrar y comprobar la integridad entre grupos.

columns.name: share_cents
columns.comment: Parte que le toca al miembro, en céntimos. Las partes de un gasto suman su importe.

indexes.name: expense_splits_expense_id_member_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expense_splits_expense_id_member_id_key ON public.expense_splits USING btree (expense_id, member_id)

indexes.name: expense_splits_group_created_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX expense_splits_group_created_idx ON public.expense_splits USING btree (group_id, created_at)

indexes.name: expense_splits_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expense_splits_pkey ON public.expense_splits USING btree (id)

constraints.name: expense_splits_expense_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (expense_id, group_id) REFERENCES expenses(id, group_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: expense_splits_member_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (member_id, group_id) REFERENCES members(id, group_id)

tables.name: public.expenses
tables.comment: Hecho central: alguien pagó una cantidad por algo. El saldo no se guarda, se calcula a partir de estas filas.

columns.name: amount_cents
columns.comment: Importe en céntimos (20 EUR = 2000). Siempre mayor que 0.

columns.name: category_id
columns.comment: Categoría opcional del gasto.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.comment: Si tiene valor, el gasto está borrado. Nunca se borra de verdad.

columns.name: expense_date
columns.comment: Día del gasto, sin hora, para que no cambie de mes por la zona horaria.

columns.name: paid_id
columns.comment: Miembro que pagó el gasto.

columns.name: recurring_expense_id
columns.comment: Plantilla recurrente de la que viene este gasto, si la hay.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Se actualiza sola con un trigger. Sirve para sincronizar cambios.

indexes.name: expenses_group_updated_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX expenses_group_updated_idx ON public.expenses USING btree (group_id, updated_at)

indexes.name: expenses_id_group_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expenses_id_group_id_key ON public.expenses USING btree (id, group_id)

indexes.name: expenses_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expenses_pkey ON public.expenses USING btree (id)

indexes.name: expenses_recurring_date_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expenses_recurring_date_key ON public.expenses USING btree (recurring_expense_id, expense_date) WHERE (recurring_expense_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: expenses_category_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (category_id, group_id) REFERENCES categories(id, group_id) ON DELETE SET NULL (category_id)

constraints.name: expenses_paid_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (paid_id, group_id) REFERENCES members(id, group_id)

constraints.name: expenses_recurring_expense_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (recurring_expense_id, group_id) REFERENCES recurring_expenses(id, group_id) ON DELETE SET NULL (recurring_expense_id)

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.expenses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.group_invites
tables.comment: Códigos de invitación para entrar en un grupo. Caducan y son de un solo uso. Solo se tocan mediante funciones.

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Código que se comparte. Único en toda la tabla.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.comment: Fecha de caducidad de la invitación.

columns.name: used_at
columns.comment: Cuándo se canjeó. Vacío significa sin usar.

columns.name: used_by
columns.comment: Miembro que entró en el grupo con esta invitación.

indexes.name: group_invites_code_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX group_invites_code_key ON public.group_invites USING btree (code)

indexes.name: group_invites_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX group_invites_pkey ON public.group_invites USING btree (id)

constraints.name: group_invites_created_by_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (created_by, group_id) REFERENCES members(id, group_id)

constraints.name: group_invites_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES expense_groups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.members
tables.comment: Una persona dentro de un grupo. Se enlaza con la cuenta de login de Supabase.

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Nombre que se muestra en el grupo.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Se actualiza sola con un trigger. Sirve para sincronizar cambios.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Cuenta de login (auth.users) de esta persona.

indexes.name: members_group_id_user_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX members_group_id_user_id_key ON public.members USING btree (group_id, user_id)

indexes.name: members_group_updated_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX members_group_updated_idx ON public.members USING btree (group_id, updated_at)

indexes.name: members_id_group_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX members_id_group_id_key ON public.members USING btree (id, group_id)

indexes.name: members_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX members_pkey ON public.members USING btree (id)

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.members FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.recurring_expense_splits
tables.comment: Reparto de una plantilla recurrente. Igual que expense_splits.

indexes.name: recurring_expense_splits_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recurring_expense_splits_pkey ON public.recurring_expense_splits USING btree (id)

indexes.name: recurring_expense_splits_recurring_expense_id_member_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recurring_expense_splits_recurring_expense_id_member_id_key ON public.recurring_expense_splits USING btree (recurring_expense_id, member_id)

indexes.name: recurring_splits_group_created_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX recurring_splits_group_created_idx ON public.recurring_expense_splits USING btree (group_id, created_at)

constraints.name: recurring_expense_splits_member_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (member_id, group_id) REFERENCES members(id, group_id)

constraints.name: recurring_expense_splits_recurring_expense_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (recurring_expense_id, group_id) REFERENCES recurring_expenses(id, group_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.recurring_expenses
tables.comment: Plantilla de un gasto que se repite cada mes. No es un gasto: genera uno real cada mes.

columns.name: day_of_month
columns.comment: Día del mes en que toca, entre 1 y 28 (el 29, 30 y 31 no existen en todos los meses).

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: Permite pausar o terminar la plantilla sin borrarla.

columns.name: next_run_on
columns.comment: Próxima fecha en la que toca generar un gasto real. La actualiza solo la función generate_recurring_expenses.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Se actualiza sola con un trigger. Sirve para sincronizar cambios.

indexes.name: recurring_expenses_group_updated_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX recurring_expenses_group_updated_idx ON public.recurring_expenses USING btree (group_id, updated_at)

indexes.name: recurring_expenses_id_group_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recurring_expenses_id_group_id_key ON public.recurring_expenses USING btree (id, group_id)

indexes.name: recurring_expenses_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recurring_expenses_pkey ON public.recurring_expenses USING btree (id)

constraints.name: recurring_expenses_category_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (category_id, group_id) REFERENCES categories(id, group_id) ON DELETE SET NULL (category_id)

constraints.name: recurring_expenses_paid_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (paid_id, group_id) REFERENCES members(id, group_id)

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.recurring_expenses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.settlements
tables.comment: Pagos entre dos miembros para saldar deuda. No son gastos: no hay compra ni categoría.

columns.name: amount_cents
columns.comment: Importe en céntimos. Siempre mayor que 0.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.comment: Si tiene valor, el pago está borrado. Nunca se borra de verdad.

columns.name: from_member_id
columns.comment: Miembro que paga.

columns.name: to_member_id
columns.comment: Miembro que recibe el pago.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Se actualiza sola con un trigger. Sirve para sincronizar cambios.

indexes.name: settlements_group_updated_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX settlements_group_updated_idx ON public.settlements USING btree (group_id, updated_at)

indexes.name: settlements_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settlements_pkey ON public.settlements USING btree (id)

constraints.name: settlements_from_member_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (from_member_id, group_id) REFERENCES members(id, group_id)

constraints.name: settlements_to_member_id_group_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (to_member_id, group_id) REFERENCES members(id, group_id)

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.settlements FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
